method_note: Counted the 116 oral technical sessions of the 35th ISTS (Tokushima, 12-18 Jul 2025) in the official Final Program paper list; 496 distinct paper numbers (2025-x-n-m) were counted across them. The technical poster session and the Student Finalist Session (S) were not counted; plenaries, NSAT/special events and the Spacecraft Control System Design Contest excluded. Sessions were mapped by their 19 official technical-session categories, refined per session for categories d (Astrodynamics/GNC), f (Small Satellite), k (Exploration), m and r and for session a-10 (Supersonic). Some session titles were reconstructed from the PDF's broken table layout. Each session = 1 unit split across at most 2 keywords. The next edition (36th, Toyama, July 2027) has not yet taken place. Keywords below 0.02 (air-propulsion, od-nav, osam, rovers, space-robotics; together 0.052 of session-units) were dropped and the remaining weights renormalized to sum to 1.
